source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The technical experience of the surgical and anesthesia teams assigned to provide the procedure","B":"The insurance authorization category used to approve the planned procedure and anesthetic care","C":"The client's pre-anesthesia physical health status and the burden of systemic disease present","D":"The predicted surgical outcome based only on procedure type, complexity, and expected duration"}}
source_row.rationale: The ASA Physical Status Classification System communicates the patient's pre-anesthesia physical health and systemic disease burden. It is associated with perioperative risk but is not, by itself, a complete surgical-risk prediction tool.
source_row.source_detail: ASA Physical Status Classification System: classification describes pre-anesthesia physical status/systemic disease burden; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: American Society of Anesthesiologists — ASA Physical Status Classification System
source_row.stem: A nurse reviews a client's ASA Physical Status classification before surgery. What does this classification primarily describe?
